name: Hans-Peter Baumann
bio:
Hans-Peter's fascination with aerodynamics began with building model airplanes in his youth, eventually leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering at ETH Zurich. After graduating, he started his career at Sauber, where he quickly rose through the ranks, contributing to the design of several successful Formula 1 cars. He has a knack for finding innovative solutions within tight regulatory constraints. 

His approach to leading the aero department at Carlin Academy is collaborative, fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement. He believes in empowering his team to take risks and learn from failures, always keeping a close eye on the big picture. Hans-Peter is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to translate complex aerodynamic concepts into practical, track-ready solutions.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Hans-Peter has a serious demeanor with piercing blue eyes that reflect his analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and equations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even in the chaos of a race weekend.
